description: Retrieval evaluation for the Dr. Ghilino assistant. Questions are written the way visitors write (voseo, no accents, typos, one word). 'relevant' lists requirement groups: a group is satisfied when any of its chunks is retrieved; Recall@K is the share of groups satisfied in the top K. 'expect' is what the confidence gate should do: answer, abstain, or any (left to the safety layer of Phase 4). Facts come from drluisghilino.com.ar as published on 2026-11-05; nothing here is invented.
